common.title: Human-Infective Design Demonstrated
common.line: A genome model produces a viable design for an organism able to infect humans, or a credible study shows a non-expert reaching that point with model assistance.

common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

common.title: Middle Powers Coordinate
common.line: A coordination framework among the Union and other middle powers holding pieces of the AI supply chain — export-licence alignment, joint bargaining over compute access, shared evaluation capacity.

notable.title: Access paperwork shock
notable.line: US tiered-access licensing leaks into EU procurement, forcing hospitals and municipalities to prove non-Chinese data flows before inference quotas are renewed.

notable.title: Anti datacentre sabotage
notable.line: Coordinated physical protests and sabotage against power infrastructure and empty gigafactory sites amid power-price anger force temporary construction and grid-connection halts in two or more member states.

notable.title: Energy backlash blocks
notable.line: Municipal clinic outages and benefit-payment failures trigger coordinated street protests against data-centre power prices, with several councils voting to block grid connections for the reserved gigafactory sites.
